name: alert-dialog
title: Alert dialog
description: Confirm before something destructive. Cancel and confirm, controlled by you.
htmlExample:
<bef-button variant="destructive"><bef-trash-icon></bef-trash-icon> Delete employee</bef-button>
<bef-alert-dialog :open="false" destructive title="Delete this employee?" description="Their records are removed from payroll and cannot be recovered." confirm-label="Delete" emit="open-change"></bef-alert-dialog>
